indications_marketed: Solid tumors in companion animals (feline sarcoma, canine soft tissue sarcoma, equine ocular squamous cell carcinoma, etc.)
regulatory: FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine 2018 device classification — premarket approval not required
marketed_devices.note: 1,200% YoY increase in administered therapies 2024->2025 reported by company; Animal Therapy Division targeting breakeven 2026.

excluded_preclinical.asset: RadioGel (Y-90 hydrogel) in human solid tumors
indications: Locoregional / recurrent papillary thyroid carcinoma; head & neck tumors accessible by direct needle injection
excluded_preclinical.regulatory_status: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation granted Dec 2023; IDE submission rejected Aug 13 2025; sterility-focused pre-submission filed Oct 14 2025; planned IDE resubmission early 2026
excluded_preclinical.reason: No active US IDE clinical trial; pre-IND-equivalent stage. India-based exploratory human treatments through Vivos Scientific India LLP began Dec 2024 but are not registered on a public clinical trial registry (CTRI/India, CT.gov, EUCT, or jRCT).

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated preclinical / veterinary studies, not company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Yttrium-90 brachytherapy device company. RadioGel (human) is at FDA Breakthrough Device / pre-IDE stage — IDE was rejected Aug 2025 and the company is preparing a resubmission for early 2026; no active US pivotal/IDE clinical study and no NCT registration. India human treatments are exploratory and not registered on a public trial registry. IsoPet (veterinary) is commercial and excluded from the human-clinical pipeline.
